description:
## Failure

Three copies of "find the object storage backend" disagree about where it lives in node config:

- `Coordinator.Server.get_object_storage_backend/1` and `PersistencePhase.get_object_storage_backend/1` read `node_config[:object_storage]` (TOP level), else derive `LocalFilesystem` at `<first capability path>/object_storage`.
- `ClusterSupervisor.children_for_capabilities/3` -> `ensure_object_storage/1` reads `object_storage` from the merged `log:`/`materializer:`/`worker:` sections, else derives from that section's path.

Configuring S3/MinIO the way a Foreman-centric reader would (`log: [path: ..., object_storage: s3]`) gives workers S3 while the coordinator and director silently read and write the cluster bootstrap on per-node local disk — each node gets its own bootstrap, and a multi-node cluster loses its cold-boot anchor. Configuring only top level gives the reverse. Found while building the ../bedrock_ex MinIO harness; the workaround there sets both. Present on origin/develop.

## Expected

One resolution of the object storage backend from node config, used by all three sites, so no configuration can split the cluster's durable state across backends.
title: [BUG] object_storage config is read from two places: top level for coordinator/persistence, capability sections for Foreman
